steps.command:
set -e; ip addr flush dev r1-eth0; ip addr add 10.0.12.1/30 dev r1-eth0; ip addr add 10.1.1.1/32 dev lo; ip link set lo up; ip link set r1-eth0 up; sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; d=/var/run/frr/mnr-ospf-r1; mkdir -p $d /etc/frr/mnr-ospf-r1; : > /etc/frr/mnr-ospf-r1/vtysh.conf; chown frr:frr $d; chmod 775 $d; printf 'hostname r1
log file %s/zebra-runtime.log
' "$d" > $d/zebra.conf; printf 'hostname r1
log file %s/ospfd-runtime.log
router ospf
 ospf router-id 1.1.1.1
 network 10.0.12.0/30 area 0
 network 10.1.1.1/32 area 0
' "$d" > $d/ospfd.conf; /usr/lib/frr/zebra -d -N mnr-ospf-r1 -f $d/zebra.conf -i $d/zebra.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/zebra.log 2>&1; /usr/lib/frr/ospfd -d -N mnr-ospf-r1 -f $d/ospfd.conf -i $d/ospfd.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/ospfd.log 2>&1

set -e; ip addr flush dev r2-eth0; ip addr add 10.0.12.2/30 dev r2-eth0; ip addr add 10.2.2.2/32 dev lo; ip link set lo up; ip link set r2-eth0 up; sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; d=/var/run/frr/mnr-ospf-r2; mkdir -p $d /etc/frr/mnr-ospf-r2; : > /etc/frr/mnr-ospf-r2/vtysh.conf; chown frr:frr $d; chmod 775 $d; printf 'hostname r2
log file %s/zebra-runtime.log
' "$d" > $d/zebra.conf; printf 'hostname r2
log file %s/ospfd-runtime.log
router ospf
 ospf router-id 2.2.2.2
 network 10.0.12.0/30 area 0
 network 10.2.2.2/32 area 0
' "$d" > $d/ospfd.conf; /usr/lib/frr/zebra -d -N mnr-ospf-r2 -f $d/zebra.conf -i $d/zebra.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/zebra.log 2>&1; /usr/lib/frr/ospfd -d -N mnr-ospf-r2 -f $d/ospfd.conf -i $d/ospfd.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/ospfd.log 2>&1
vtysh -N mnr-ospf-r1 -c 'show ip ospf neighbor' | grep Full
